description: Evacuate one island fully, then reuse its high dock as a transfer point: the bridge closes the south breach and the whole south market walks home; the depot skiff drops the north market at the emptied south high dock (a staging point, not a refuge) and they are walked on over the bridge once all five are there; the west-pier skiff lands the west market at the receiving dock and the high-landing skiff lands the east market at the high landing, one boat per berth.
